messages:
alice: Paging oncall — EU-west economy tier showing sustained 95th p50 token latency > 2.5s and error rate creeping up, customers reporting slow chat responses. Incident bot triggered: INCIDENT-4829.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC-4829 created. Severity: P2. Affected service: smart-routing. Pager: ben.
ben: on it. tagging eng-sre and runtime. initial ask: do we have a temporary gating we can apply to economy/regional steer to push traffic to higher-priority lanes?
chandra: product note — multiple smaller customers in EU are impacted, not enterprise SLAs yet but user experience bad. prefer not to drop requests if avoidable.
alice: agree. prioritize graceful gating: 1) cap economy-per-region qps to 25% of baseline, 2) enable regional fallback to eu->us-east premium lane for burst, 3) disable economy-prefetch caching so we don't amplify KV misses.
ben: running proposed changes now. patching smart-routing policy. command: ``curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/policies/steer/patch -d '{"region":"eu-west","tier":"economy","max_qps_pct":25,"fallback":"premium-us-east"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN'``
deploy-bot: Deploy started for policy patch (deploy id: dp-7891). Expect < 30s to apply.
ben: applied. verifying metrics. pinging dashboards.
frank: seeing immediate drop in queue depth on eu-west economy nodes. Latency 95th down from 2.6s -> 1.4s within 45s. :thumbsup:
chandra: can we also temporarily raise per-customer quota for premium tier to absorb redirected traffic? I can sign off on short-term limits until midnight UTC.
alice: authorized. ben, please increase premium burst quota for eu region by +30% and set TTL 8h.
ben: quota bump applied via admin UI (change id q-332). Also opened canary to monitor error budget.
incident-bot: Note: automatic rollback timer set for 8h unless manually cleared.
ben: one weirdness — a small bump in model OOMs on premium in us-east after redirect; killing a few noisy sessions (session-ids: s-908, s-911) to free cache. root cause investigation ongoing.
frank: ops command used: ``rekill-sessions --ids s-908,s-911 --reason redirect-pressure``. No further OOMs so far.
chandra: taking customer comms: drafted message to affected customers explaining temporary gating and remediation steps. Will post to status.redwood shortly after we stabilize.
alice: timeline/logging: please add annotations in tracing for requests that were routed via fallback lane so we can measure quality/regression.
ben: added tag header x-routing-fallback: eu->us-east on rerouted requests. collecting samples.
frank: prelim sample quality looks same for short prompts, longer context shows slight token delay but within acceptable bounds.
ben: monitoring for 15 more minutes, will keep oncall looped. If OOMs resume, plan B is to enable 50% token-penalty for economy (rate limiting tokens rather than requests).
chandra: good escalation plan. set up a short postmortem doc and assign owners: routing policy (ben), runtime OOM analysis (frank), customer comms (chandra).
alice: thanks team. tagging @here for visibility — keep updates brief.
incident-bot: INC-4829 updated: mitigated (gating applied). Next: RCA and follow-ups.
ben: last check: 95th latency stable ~1.2s, error rate back to baseline. moving to monitoring state.
frank: leaving oncall notes in ops-runbook under /incidents/INC-4829; will attach dashboards.
chandra: published status page update and notified affected customers. closing active mitigation thread.
alice: nice work. mark as resolved in 2h unless regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
